race.comment: ALFA DUNDEE (3) had been in sparkling form so headed to town and wasn't disgraced over 2020m at Doomben. Back at home in easier grade and expected to bounce back. POWER PACK (1) was fourth but beaten less than a length last time over 2000m at Ipswich. Tricky draw but should take plenty of beating. HABERFIELD (6) was a course and distance winner two back then fourth here last time. Has a strong record this course and distance and can immediately atone. OUR BRAVE LINI (7) has a tricky gate but is close to another win and should run well. MONTEVECCHIO (10) has also drawn wide but will be charging home late.
